AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Integrated Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Storage of Crop Produce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Ice melting to water

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

3. B — 100 °C

4. B — Glucose and oxygen

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

6. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. A — newton (N)

8. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

11. C — Producers

12. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Organic Gardening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
